content.short: Prividium is an institutional-grade, private L2 framework built on ZKsync for secure and compliant finance.
content.description:
Prividium is a pioneering blockchain framework developed by ZKsync, designed to provide financial institutions with the privacy and compliance needed for professional-grade digital asset management. By utilizing the ZK Stack, the platform allows organizations to operate private, permissioned Layer 2 networks where sensitive transaction data—such as trade details and participant identities—stays completely off-chain. This ensures that institutional confidentiality is maintained while still anchoring the network's overall security to the Ethereum mainnet via zero-knowledge proofs.

Featuring advanced identity management and selective disclosure for auditors, Prividium acts as the "bank stack of Ethereum," bridging the gap between traditional banking requirements and decentralized settlement. The protocol is built for high scalability and interoperability, enabling institutions to integrate digital assets into their existing workflows with sub-second finality. Through its focus on verifiable privacy, Prividium is empowering the next generation of financial infrastructure where institutional control meets decentralized cryptographic security.
content.meta: Prividium provides private, permissioned Layer 2 blockchain infrastructure for institutional compliance and secure finance.
